source_text.body:
Plan toddler meals without repeats
A parent used a Zapier agent for toddler meal planning, with a Google Sheet as memory so it doesn't suggest the same meals weekly.
Done with
ZA
Zapier Agents
What they did
The parent first used ChatGPT deep research to compile dietary recommendations, then built a Zapier agent to turn that guidance into a weekly meal plan. The agent used a Google Sheet as memory so it could avoid repeating meals from prior weeks, and the parent shared a reusable template that others can copy and customize with their own dietary-guidelines document.
How it went
The source only says it produced weekly meal plans and avoided repeating the same meals each week. It gives no performance numbers or clear account of what did not work.
Worth knowing
You need to supply your own dietary-guidelines document if you copy the shared template.
Try it yourself
with
Zapier Agents
Copy prompt
Create a Zapier agent that plans [number] days of meals for my [age] toddler each week. Use a Google Sheet at [sheet link] as memory: read past meals first, avoid repeating anything from the last [number] weeks, then add the new plan. Account for [allergies, dislikes, dietary needs], and finish with a meal plan and grocery list. Show me the plan before emailing or saving it anywhere else.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/zapier/comments/1kdzmeo
